name: Yamamura Misa Suspense: Kyoto Zaitech Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 山村美紗サスペンス 京都財テク殺人事件
source:
Main heroine goes to a meeting with best friends. But one friend goes missing. Soon friend's dead body is found. Protagonist starts an investigation to discover the circumstances of sudden death.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角去和最好的朋友开会。但一位朋友失踪了。很快朋友的尸体就被发现了。主角开始调查猝死的原因。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
